title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Context: add a set of opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, language-agnostic quickstarts for tool-calling, and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to onboard RAG workflows and tool-calling agents with vetted templates, runnable examples (Python/TypeScript), and a living docs page with interactive snippets. What this PR does: adds three RAG agent templates (faq-bot, sales-assistant, analytic-agent), two quickstarts (python, typescript) that demonstrate tool-calling and streaming responses, updates docs site pages under /docs/guides/agents/ with architecture diagrams and sample prompts, and includes small improvements to the agent SDK for clearer error messages and better type hints. Testing: unit tests for examples harnessed in eval-harness, integration smoke tests against the local dev runtime, and docs site build validation. Related: ENG-2148 (RAG templates rollout), ENG-2173 (agent quickstart tracking), SUP-7621 (customer ask for faster onboarding). Notes: kept templates minimal but production-ready (configurable chunking, pre-filtering, fallback policy).
